conditions.displayName: An uptime check fails from at least 2 of 3 regions for 2 minutes

documentation.content:
The /health check on the host named in this incident (app. or merchants.) has failed from at least 2 of 3 regions for 2 minutes.

- Open the VM over IAP SSH and run `docker ps` and `systemctl status caddy`.
- Caddy answers 502 when the container behind it is down.
